propositions: Legacy stores lack .bridge_state/projects.json and bridge_project field on tickets, causing sync to stop on upgrade unless migrated
Migration must seed the projects mapping and set legacy_default as an idempotent ensure unit (not per-ticket EDIT events) to avoid silent convergence failures under MCP lock contention
Ensure units must write zero ticket events and be re-runnable; a second sweep produces no new commits and returns ok
One-project stores must not receive multi-project-bridge capability stamp; two-project stores must receive it exactly once as a convergence backstop
Two new ensure unit ids must be registered in REGISTRY_IDS and _registry(), and the frozen test literal updated to maintain registry agreement
A store with multi-project-bridge stamp must still pass check_store_compat on the current binary without compat.py modifications
